source.author: verg
source.text_english: Indeed, I would also have liked to yield to the living.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: cur ergo dicebat eodem ipso tempore quo uinctos homines ad immolationem mittebat: equidem et uiuis concedere uellem, cum uiuos quos habebat in potestate uice pecudum iuberet occidi?
reuse.text_original: cur ergo dicebat eodem ipso tempore quo uinctos homines ad immolationem mittebat: equidem et uiuis concedere uellem, cum uiuos quos habebat in potestate uice pecudum iuberet occidi?
reuse.text_english: Why then was he saying at that very same time, when he was sending chained men to be sacrificed: I too should indeed have wished to spare the living, since he was ordering the living whom he had in his power to be killed in place of cattle?
